At Worn by Water, we are committed to protecting the privacy of all visitors to our website. Please read the following privacy statement to understand how we collect, use and protect the information you provide to us.

By using this website, you consent to the collection and use of your information in accordance with this privacy statement.

What Information Do We Collect From You?

When you make a purchase, you may be asked to provide certain information about yourself, such as your name, address, email address, telephone number and payment details.

We may also collect information about your use of our website, including information about browsing activity and interactions with our services.

How We Use Your Information

We may analyse information provided by you and others to help us administer, support and improve our business and website.

We may use your information to contact you regarding important changes or developments to our website, services or your order, or to obtain your feedback about our services.

Where you have given your consent, we may also use your information to let you know about products, services or other updates that may be of interest to you. This contact may be by post, telephone, SMS or email.

If you wish to stop receiving marketing communications from us, you can opt out at any time by contacting us using the details below:

Third-Party Disclosure

We will never sell or rent your personal information to a third party without your consent.

We will not otherwise share, sell or distribute the personal information you provide to us except where necessary to provide our services, fulfil your orders, comply with legal obligations, or where you have given us permission to do so.

IP Addresses

An IP address is a number that is automatically assigned to your computer or device when you use the internet.

When you visit our website, our servers may record your IP address. We may use this information to help diagnose problems with our server, administer and improve our website, and understand general patterns of website usage.

Cookies and Web Beacons

A cookie is a small file sent to your browser from a web server and stored on your device. Cookies are commonly used by websites to remember preferences and improve the user experience.

Our website may use cookies and similar technologies, including web beacons, to monitor website usage and improve our services. We may also use cookies to provide content and functionality that are more relevant to your interests.

You can adjust your browser settings to reject or restrict cookies. However, doing so may affect the functionality of certain parts of the website.

Security

We take reasonable security measures to protect your personal information from unauthorised access, unlawful processing, accidental loss, destruction or damage.

Data Retention

We will retain your personal information for as long as reasonably necessary to fulfil the purposes for which it was collected, or for as long as required by applicable law.

If You Want to Change Your Information

You are entitled to request access to the personal information we hold about you.

If you wish to request access to your information, please contact us with appropriate proof of identification:

Worn by Water
Galway Road

Co. Galway

Ireland

Email: Aoife@wornbywater.com

You may also ask us to correct or amend any personal information we hold about you to ensure that it is accurate and up to date.

Changes to Our Privacy Statement

Any changes to this Privacy Policy in the future will be posted on our website. Where appropriate, we may also notify you of significant changes by email.
